description: Every expression the Varka compiler fuses, with the Catalyst expression classes each one resolves to. Anything absent runs on Spark's row engine. A row whose kernel can decline a batch names its domain, the predicate inside which the kernel answers (under ANSI where the modes differ); outside it the batch goes to the row engine. An empty domain means every input of the column types is answered. The switches are the family settings that keep the row off Varka, the families whose nodes its kernel holds; empty for a row that compiles to a bare column read.
